capabilities: Embed live Sandpack code editors with previews in notes
Run Python blocks in a sandboxed worker via Pyodide
Persist playground edits to per-block JSON sidecar files
Override template, theme, layout and panel visibility per block
extras: Prominent privacy warning: playground code is transmitted to CodeSandbox's hosted bundler and code can be sent to the network; a self-hosted bundler URL can redirect it. Previews and first Python runs need internet; no offline mode. Mobile support is experimental and Python blocks are not tested on mobile. Edits less than 1 s before closing a note can be lost; unused sidecar cleanup is manual.
problem: Obsidian code blocks are static text, so there is no way to run code or show a live preview in place while writing notes.

relations.evidence: Embed live, editable Sandpack code playgrounds inside your Obsidian notes.
Sandpack sends the code you type in a playground to CodeSandbox's hosted bundler service

summary: Embeds live, editable Sandpack code playgrounds (React, Vue, Svelte, HTML/CSS, Python via Pyodide) with instant preview inside notes.
